facts.fact: ch12 开场：孩子军团的首领 Nibs 命令不要打扰沙滩上的一对父子
facts.anchor: “Leave them alone!” whispers Nibs

facts.fact: 瘦削的孩子（即 Michele 与其父）在木林边缘被窥视
facts.anchor: From the edge of the wood, the skinny child is spying on two people on the beach, an adult and a young boy

facts.fact: Nibs 说扈从还差最后一个女孩
facts.anchor: We’ve got to get the last girl for the Retinue

facts.fact: 招满最后一人之后，一切就正式开始
facts.anchor: Then it begins

facts.fact: Wendy 宿醉醒来，口中黏腻；Giada 把百叶窗留开惹她难受
facts.anchor: The Wondrous Wendy wakes up with her mouth sticky

facts.fact: 她留宿 Giada 家不是头一次
facts.anchor: It’s happened before that she’s slept over at Giada’s

facts.fact: Peter 睡在沙发上盖着 Poochie 毛毯
facts.anchor: Peter’s asleep on the sofa, with a Poochie blanket over him

facts.fact: 两天里 Peter 已像八岁孩子：一头黑卷发、额上两只小角
facts.anchor: he could already be a child of eight, with a mop of black curls and two little horns on his forehead

facts.fact: 原文断言：随着成长，Peter 的人性在增加
facts.anchor: As he grows, his humanity increases

facts.fact: 邻居清晨吵架；曾几何时两女贴墙听戏取乐
facts.anchor: There was a time when she and Giada would press an ear to the wall and enjoy the show

facts.fact: Wendy 评邻居： depressing 且 common 的人生
facts.anchor: What depressing lives, thinks the Wondrous Wendy, and what common lives

facts.fact: Wendy 对 Giovanni 说过：活成那样宁可去死
facts.anchor: Once she told Giovanni that if she ever turned out like that, she’d rather be killed

facts.fact: Wendy 盘算 Augusto 昨到店里找她的动机，并认定父亲说他不干净是对的
facts.anchor: what the hell did Augusto want? Papa was right, he’s a bad person, anything but clean

facts.fact: 她的结论：Dal Mare 最后犯了错——叫出了她的艺名
facts.anchor: The moron had made a mistake at the end: he called her Wondrous Wendy

facts.fact: 点破「叫出对方喜欢的名号以建立共谋」是老魔术心理术套路
facts.anchor: It’s an old mentalist trick, Wendy uses it to get the marks she picks from the audience to lower their guard

facts.fact: 前夜她们一边查书一边喝 Primitivo di Manduria——顺得像啤酒的骗人红酒
facts.anchor: They’d been pulling down books, chatting and drinking Primitivo di Manduria, a good, strong, deceptive red wine that goes down like beer

facts.fact: 酒后她们裁定：Peter 是 faun，古罗马的imps，希腊 satyrs 的本地版
facts.anchor: After five or six glasses, and an undefined number of books they decided: Peter is a faun, one of the imps of Ancient Rome, the local equivalent of the Greek satyrs

facts.fact: 夸张比喻：Giada 藏书密度超过 Umberto Eco
facts.anchor: Giada has more books per square metre than Umberto Eco

facts.fact: 但也仅此而已：仍无法解释一只幼年 faun 为何出现在垃圾斗
facts.anchor: There’s a big gap from that to figuring out what a baby faun was doing in a rubbish skip

facts.fact: Peter 过来把脸颊贴上她的腿，像小狗
facts.anchor: he comes and lays his cheek against her leg, like a puppy

facts.fact: Peter 的身体发育包括阴茎（静息也已八英寸以上），Giada 给他买短裤
facts.anchor: his penis has grown too (by now it has to be more than eight inches long at rest)

facts.fact: Wendy 对 Peter 开玩笑说别把我养成酒鬼
facts.anchor: “I won’t let you make an alcoholic of me,” she admonishes

facts.fact: Giada 说「you're adorable」后吻了 Wendy 的嘴
facts.anchor: she kisses her on the mouth

facts.fact: 二女唇贴唇停了一瞬
facts.anchor: They stay like that for a moment, bodies close, lips touching lips

facts.fact: Wendy 第一次体会女人触碰的质地：柔软、愉悦
facts.anchor: So this is how a woman’s touch feels, Wendy thinks. The texture is different, soft. Pleasing.

facts.fact: Giada 突然退开道歉
facts.anchor: Giada pulls back abruptly. “Sorry,” she says hastily, “I didn’t…”

facts.fact: Wendy 耸肩推给酒；但她的脸红出卖了她
facts.anchor: The Wondrous Wendy shrugs. “Wine plays weird tricks.”

facts.fact: Luisa 醒来在大型木船的禁闭舱地板上
facts.anchor: She’s sitting on the floor of the brig of a large wooden ship

facts.fact: 舱里血迹未清：Luisa 忍吐的推理显示海盗不打扫
facts.anchor: they didn’t clean up the blood, they certainly won’t come to clean up vomit

facts.fact: 海盗扒光她衣但未强奸——叙述者判定虎克克不许强奸，因他不蠢
facts.anchor: Captain Hook is not so stupid as to allow rapes

facts.fact: Luisa 原以为被带走会更晚——她被掳进船底
facts.anchor: Luisa thought that it would take longer

facts.fact: 她后悔没趁早与 Giovanni 摊牌：他注意到变化却无从知道原因
facts.anchor: He noticed the change, and he had no way of knowing the reasons

facts.fact: 提灯来的海盗竟是 Luisa 认得的人：她脱口喊出 Fatty Bolger
facts.anchor: “Fatty Bolger!” she exclaims

facts.fact: Giovanni 的导师（前文绰号 Fatty Bolger）答：不再是了
facts.anchor: “Not any more,” says the old professor

facts.fact: Silvia 醒在儿子 Giovanni 旧的房间里
facts.anchor: Once it belonged to Giovanni

facts.fact: Stefano 夜里常发动物般的惨叫，Silvia 整夜难眠
facts.anchor: Sometimes at night he starts screaming bloody murder, terrible screams, like an animal at the slaughterhouse

facts.fact: 每小时三百欧的专家给的建议是：换房间睡
facts.anchor: Change rooms, was the advice of a specialist who cost three hundred euros an hour

facts.fact: Michele 高烧未退、汗透沉睡；Silvia 想今天不退烧就再叫医生
facts.anchor: She touches Michele’s forehead. It’s still scorching, and he’s deeply asleep, soaked in sweat

facts.fact: Silvia 怀念旧晨：Stefano 的吻、热牛奶烤面包、来自 Nemi 的草莓酱
facts.anchor: When the morning began with a kiss from Stefano, with hot milk and bread toasting, butter and strawberry jam from Nemi

facts.fact: 原文以 Alzheimer's is anarchic 说明丈夫作息无常
facts.anchor: Alzheimer’s is anarchic, it doesn’t recognise rules

facts.fact: Silvia 进丈夫房间先感不对：不是看的，是听的——本该在的声音没了
facts.anchor: It isn’t something to see, it’s something to hear. A sound that should be there and isn’t.

facts.fact: 她两步奔到床前：Stefano 安静躺着，少了那条她比自己的呼吸还熟的低鸣
facts.anchor: She runs to the bed, reaches it in two strides. Stefano lies peacefully, but without that soft rumble that she knows better than her own breath

facts.fact: 叙述者一句定论：他已经走了，再无话可说
facts.anchor: He’s already gone, with nothing more to say.

facts.fact: Giovanni 在露台独自消化：父亲死了，彻彻底底
facts.anchor: Papa is dead—dead dead, dead as a doornail, dead forever

facts.fact: Giovanni 第一次见尸体：尸体奇怪，像人偶
facts.anchor: They’re strange things, corpses, they’re like dolls

facts.fact: 死者失去姿态表情与胸腔的持续起伏——失去自身，可以说连灵魂也失去
facts.anchor: The dead lose gestures, expressions, the constant movement of the ribcage, lose themselves, lose their souls, you’d have to say

facts.fact: 同一具尸体前，人类学家与儿子两种身份同时发问
facts.anchor: Why did you die now? he thought as a son

facts.fact: 丧父之痛让 Giovanni 想与 Luisa 和解，眼睛的事暂搁
facts.anchor: he needs to make up, eyes or no

facts.fact: 失去至亲之一，他第一次理解「真正永远地失去」是什么
facts.anchor: He’s lost one of the people he loved most in the world, and so he has understood what it means to lose someone, lose them for real, forever

facts.fact: Angela 到场即问妹妹最挂心的两件事：Mama 与 Michele 的烧
facts.anchor: Michele?”

facts.fact: Angela 未落一泪、眼睛清醒警觉——她受击会以双倍力度反应
facts.anchor: Not a single tear streaks her face, her eyes are awake and alert

facts.fact: Giovanni 以为与 Luisa 吵架是秘密，但瞒不住 Wendy
facts.anchor: keeping secrets from the Wondrous Wendy is difficult

facts.fact: Falco 医生推断死因：又一次中风，迟早会发生
facts.anchor: “It must have been a stroke,” he says.

facts.fact: 医生补一句「对 Stefano 反而是好事」，Angela 当场想打他
facts.anchor: This was for the best, for Stefano

facts.fact: Angela 承认真正的父亲早已死去、剩下的只是容器——但她爱那个容器
facts.anchor: Angela knows perfectly that Papa, the real Papa, has been dead for a long time, and what remained was just a container. But she loved that container

facts.fact: 父亲的口头禅：一切都是 Enchantment；教她认识 Wonder 的人也是他
facts.anchor: Everything is Enchantment, Papa used to repeat to her, and it was he who taught her about Wonder

facts.fact: Falco 给了 Michele 退烧药，说别的都不必做、让病程走完
facts.anchor: Falco gave him antipyretic that was supposed to bring down his fever

facts.fact: 守在病弟床边时 Angela 察觉：担忧只占一半，另一半是愤怒
facts.anchor: Angela realises that concern is only half the story. There’s also anger

facts.fact: 她的愤怒内容：这位曾经伟大的父亲孤独地死，被除妻子外的所有人遗弃（包括她自己与 Giovanni）
facts.anchor: he died alone, poor bastard, abandoned by everyone (yes, even by me and Giovanni) except his wife

facts.fact: Angela 的哲思：死亡是形而上的歧异，是我们人人迟早目击的唯一奇迹
facts.anchor: Death is metaphysical diversity, she thinks

facts.fact: 她吻弟弟额头收束全章：死亡想赢她，还得多下点功夫
facts.anchor: Wendy kisses her brother’s forehead. It’ll have to try harder with her.
